description: A glazed box thirty feet long in the top of the arch. The floor is one clear sheet, looking straight down on the road and the quarter, and on a clear day out to the edge of the Basin. Free entry. Two benches face outward. People stand at the glass instead.

window.description: Three sides and the floor. The Curtain runs west to east across the bottom of the view, the city stacks up to the north, and the whole of Halcyon Fields lies underneath you looking, from here, considerably emptier than it does from the street.
window.name: the span glazing

name: The Arch — The Key
